scientific_change: Common deployment leg Kd 10 -> 12 in both engines; retain original Kp500 and frozen actor, with zero additional PPO updates.
hypothesis: A modest velocity-damping increase may reduce wheel unloading without weakening static holding stiffness; the outcome is unknown.
motivation: Trial007's zero-shot Kp400 did not improve true contact continuity. A single damping perturbation is more informative than another stiffness sweep or simultaneous reward/actor change.

controller_change.linear_diagnostic: Archived trial004 free unsaturated semiimplicit-PD stability ratios become 1.688–1.777, below the bound2, versus 3.981–4.191 for the failed Kd30 setting. Damping ratios rise20%, while natural frequencies and static holding stiffness stay unchanged.
controller_change.linear_exclusions: Ground contact, actor feedback, motor clipping, joint limits and finite-amplitude dynamics are excluded; this is not a global stability or transfer guarantee.

policy.selection: One predesignated actor and one damping value, returning to original500/10 rather than combining trial007's Kp400 or using failed trial005/006 weights.

activation_prerequisites: Complete failed trial007 four-panel evidence published and GitHub branch verified.
Full regression, strict damping-metadata/stale-gain tests and historical byte-identical publisher checks pass.
Original checkpoint, manifest, asset, motion, profile and controller hashes verify unchanged.
Actual gain readback confirms Kp500/Kd12 before policy use; no silent dual-gain override.
Fresh idle GPU/UUID guard, unmasked native device audit and no changes to other users' jobs.

evaluation.conditions: Nominal motors, reference framezero and original initial velocity; no added lateral velocity, reset or hidden root write.
evaluation.recording: Complete first-episode actual200Hz states/contact patches, with unchanged50Hz policy context.
evaluation.same_actor: Verify exact checkpoint/export weights and normalizer, recorded-action replay, same actorbytes and MuJoCo reconstructed observations.
evaluation.acceptance: At least0.20s uninterrupted speed>=0.4m/s, positive forward component, abs(sideslip)>=8deg, both actual bearing ground contacts and measured mean lateral patch slip>=0.04m/s; all original tracking, support, nonwheel-impact, full-duration and stable-exit gates must also pass.
evaluation.source_fidelity: Separate original source-window overlap and sign diagnostic; no phase shift and no claim it is part of assessor gates.
evaluation.diagnostic_comparison: Actual true right-wheel unloading and source-window LINK-origin vertical RMS versus trial004; fewer gaps or lower vibration alone is not acceptance.
evaluation.format: Captured car -> TRON1 kinematic reference -> Isaac frozen policy -> MuJoCo same frozen policy; retain complete four-panel evidence even on failure.
evaluation.interpretation: This is a single zero-shot controller diagnostic, not training at Kd12, hardware readiness or statistical robustness.

resources.mode: One owned app at a time on authorized remote compute, without CUDA masking/remapping.
